resources.string: No browser is installed to open this Reddit post.
Reddit denied access. Check the approved installed-app ID and its permissions. Existing unexpired photos remain available.
Please wait before refreshing again (at least one minute, or longer if Reddit requests it). Existing unexpired photos remain available.
Could not refresh or load photos. Check your connection and try a subreddit with direct landscape images. Any usable cached photos will be kept; otherwise bundled landscapes appear.

Refresh sends your chosen subreddits and app identification to Reddit. Up to six direct Reddit-hosted JPG/PNG landscape photos from the top posts this week are kept privately for up to 48 hours, then removed when the app is active. Posts marked NSFW, spoilers, videos and galleries are excluded. Photos remain their creators’ work; posting on Reddit does not grant reuse rights. No account login, storage permission or background service is used.
